correctness.rationale: The edge-disjoint-ring argument proves that the minimum cut cardinality is at least m: with fewer than m deleted edges, at least one homologous generator ring survives in each annulus, so the target homology class remains in the image. A dual-seam cocycle on the second annulus, scaled by the reciprocal of m and extended by zero on the first, is feasible and has sum of absolute coefficients at most (2m-1)/m, which is less than two. Therefore the ratio exceeds half the integer parameter for every allowed parameter value.
